name: - CowSwap
fix_description: Add access control to envelope() (onlyOwner or whitelist callers). The function is public and executes arbitrary external calls (target.call with user-supplied callData), allowing anyone to make the contract perform any action on behalf of itself, including transferring tokens it has been approved to spend.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is essentially a single direct call into an exposed callback with attacker-controlled parameters, followed by unwrapping WETH and transferring ETH out. It is very short, requires minimal protocol-specific setup, and matches an obvious unsafe-callback/access-control style issue that an experienced auditor could reproduce quickly.
